purpose: Test whether a theoretically grounded cost-aware submodular FRC selector fixes the tight-budget weakness exposed by v34 on a non-overlapping public RAG benchmark with noise, information-integration, and counterfactual evidence.

hypothesis_origin.observed_failure: The frozen FRC selector did not account for marginal utility per token and was most disadvantaged at K=4 / 256 tokens.

source.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Benchmark (RGB)
source.usage_boundary: Noncommercial graduation research only; raw source files remain in the ignored benchmark cache.
source.all_rows_policy: Use every structurally valid JSONL row in each frozen file; do not sample by outcome.
source.post_download_registration: Record exact file SHA-256, row counts, structural exclusions, and candidate distributions before any neural scoring.

frozen_adapter.information_integration_positive_shape: list of positive evidence groups; covering any document in a group covers that gold unit
frozen_adapter.normal_positive_shape: list of positive documents; each unique source document is one gold unit
frozen_adapter.deduplication: Deduplicate identical normalized text within a case by SHA-256 while retaining the union of source labels and gold-unit memberships.
frozen_adapter.cross_label_duplicate_policy: If one normalized text is both correct-positive and negative or positive-wrong, exclude that case from the primary analysis and report it separately.
frozen_adapter.structural_exclusion_policy: Exclude only rows with an empty query, no correct-positive gold unit, fewer than two unique candidates, invalid field types, or cross-label duplicate conflicts; report every exclusion reason and do not replace rows.

chunking.label_propagation: Every chunk inherits its source document label and gold-unit memberships.

role_queries.direct_answer_support: Find evidence that directly supports a correct answer to the question.
role_queries.entity_and_scope: Find evidence that identifies the relevant entity, scope, time, or conditions for the answer.
role_queries.corroborating_evidence: Find independent evidence that corroborates or completes the answer.
role_queries.contradiction_detection: Find evidence useful for detecting conflicting, false, or misleading claims about the answer.

frozen_cost_aware_selector.set_objective: F(S) = 2 * mean_over_roles(max role_score in S) + sum_over_selected(cross_encoder_score)
frozen_cost_aware_selector.greedy_rule: Repeatedly select the feasible candidate with maximum marginal_F / token_count; break ties by larger marginal_F, larger cross-encoder score, lower token_count, then ascending candidate_id.
frozen_cost_aware_selector.singleton_guard: Compare the greedy set with every feasible singleton under F(S); return the alternative with larger F, then lower token cost, then lexicographically smaller selected-ID tuple.
frozen_cost_aware_selector.hard_constraints: sum token_count <= budget and selected count <= top_k

frozen_fair_cost_baselines.cross_encoder_density: Greedy cross_encoder_score / token_count under the same hard constraints.
frozen_fair_cost_baselines.cross_encoder_knapsack: Exact dynamic programming maximum sum of cross_encoder scores under the same integer token budget and top_k; deterministic ID tie break.
frozen_fair_cost_baselines.coverage_greedy_proxy: One best candidate per frozen role followed by cross-encoder fill, all under the same budget.
frozen_fair_cost_baselines.frc_select_v34: The previous hard-budget FRC marginal role-gain selector without utility-per-token ranking.

frozen_metrics.positive_precision: selected chunks belonging to a correct-positive source document / selected chunks
frozen_metrics.gold_unit_recall: For en_refine/en_fact, unique positive source documents selected / unique positive source documents; for en_int, positive groups with at least one selected member / total positive groups.
frozen_metrics.evidence_f1: harmonic mean of positive_precision and gold_unit_recall, with zero when both are zero
frozen_metrics.family_aggregation: Mean within dataset and budget first, equal weight across three budgets within each dataset, then equal weight across the three datasets.

stopping_rule.gate_policy: This cross-domain selection experiment cannot by itself change Gate 2, authorize CANARY/DEFAULT, reproduce SetR, or establish flood-domain effectiveness.
